composition-22.method: absolute-residual width at the 90th percentile of the 116 unused validation rows
composition-22.why_no_claim: Calibration under background shift would need several independent held-out background sets. The archive publishes no background labels and the validation rows are a single held-out set, so this is one observed coverage number on one split, not a guarantee. The historical protocol left these validation labels unused; this check is the only place they are read, and it is reported separately for that reason.

value.note: Ridge shrinkage is governed by feature variance relative to alpha. With alpha fixed and no feature scaling, the same alpha is a far heavier penalty for small-scale composition fractions than for ESM-2 embeddings, so the five configurations do not share a common amount of regularisation.
